context: Answer to REFREEZE-NET-Q (refreeze-night-1b Phase 0 stop): night 1's recapture set (34 steps) includes 10 ingestors that can only re-run by downloading their public source (8 City open-data files, the CoA CKAN datastore, the 2017 CoA decision PDFs). (A) allow the public downloads, local DB only, every source-drift hash move explained under R-DA; (B) wait for an offline record-and-replay mode.

decisions.subject: REFREEZE-NET-Q: network acquisition for night 1's ingestor recaptures
decisions.recommendation: Option A: the 10 ingestor steps re-acquire their public read-only sources during night 1's recapture (local DB writes only, under the dblock); every hash move caused by source drift is explained in explained-diffs.json under R-DA or the run stops. An offline record-and-replay mode is logged as a follow-up PIN, not a blocker.
